text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-2026 triggered — High 5xx error-rate on service inference-gateway-eu-west (>3% for 3m). Pager: alice (oncall). Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026

alice (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Can someone grab logs + customer impact? @ben @carla

pagerduty-bot: Alert acknowledged by alice (oncall). Escalation policy: standard -> if not acknowledged within 5m escalate to SRE lead.

ben (sre): Running quick check. head -n 200 from proxy logs now.

ben (sre): ```
kubectl logs -n prod deployment/inference-gateway -c proxy --since=10m | grep 'HTTP/1.1" 5' | head -n 50
# ... sample output ...
2026-03-14T03:12:21Z 10.0.0.45 POST /v1/generate 200ms \"HTTP/1.1\\\" 502\\\"\" model=canary-opt-8bit
2026-03-14T03:12:23Z 10.0.0.46 POST /v1/chat 230ms \"HTTP/1.1\\\" 503\\\"\" model=canary-opt-8bit
... 
``` 

carla (platform): I'm seeing a canary variant (canary-opt-8bit) rolled to eu-west at 03:10 UTC by automated rollout. Traffic % to canary ~12% per metrics. CPU on canary nodes spiked and started returning 5xx.

dave (prod-eng): If it's the canary, let's cut it. I'm starting a traffic shift to stable. Command: ```
kubectl set image deploy/inference-gateway inference-gateway=redwood/inference:stable && curl -X POST https://internal-routing/api/shifts -d '{"service":"inference-gateway","from":"canary","to":"stable","percent":12}'
``` will do a manual rollback/shift.

alice (oncall): Go for it. Also increase replica count while we observe.

ben (sre): Scaling failed initially due to a quota error on eu-west GPUs. Getting quota ticket in parallel. For now I'll drain canary pods from service.

ben (sre): ```
kubectl label pod <canary-pod-pfx> no-route=true -n prod
kubectl delete pod <canary-pod-pfx> -n prod
``` 

sasha (support): PS — we've got ~7 customers reporting errors in last 10m, two are high-priority (billing integrations). CS is reaching out. Customer-facing statusnote drafted: "We're investigating increased errors in EU region; mitigation in progress." :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

carla (platform): Routing change done, canary traffic now 0% (confirmed in routing console). Metrics show error-rate dropping but still elevated: 5xx from 6.2% -> 2.1% over 6 minutes.

alice (oncall): Nice. Ben can you confirm whether the KV cache warmup issue we saw in previous incidents applies? Any slow downstream (model server) errors?

ben (sre): Looks like model server process for canary was OOMKilling on some nodes. Stack traces show allocation failures in custom kernel path. Noted similar to ticket T-88. I'm gathering core dumps and will upload.

dave (prod-eng): Rolling back canary image entirely. I launched a force rollback job: ```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway -n prod --to-revision=42
``` ETA ~1m.

pagerduty-bot: Incident escalated to oncall-sre (ben) for active mitigation (policy).

alice (oncall): Good. Sasha, keep customers updated with ETA ~15m, mention degraded performance for some EU requests, apologize, offer workaround to retry with stable endpoint region us-east if possible.

sasha (support): Posted status update in status.redwood.com and pinged affected customers. Will attach logs when available.

ben (sre): Rollback complete. Error-rate trending down: 5xx now 0.9% over last 1m. No further OOMs after nodes restarted.

alice (oncall): Great. I'm going to hand this to postmortem owners. Ben/dave/carla please capture root cause hypotheses and remediation steps. Keep this thread updated. Marking P0 -> P1 monitoring.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert INC-2026 auto-resolved (no active violations). If further error-rate >3% occurs for 5m, a new alert will fire.

carla (platform): Adding temporary guardrail: pause automated canary rollouts to inference-gateway in eu-west until T-88 fixes land. Patch will be PR'd.

dave (prod-eng): I'll open a follow-up ticket to add stronger pre-deploy memory tests for custom kernels.

alice (oncall): Thanks team. Closing this paging wave for now. Follow-ups in #postmortems — assign to dave and ben. :thumbsup:
